learning_outcomes.text: Knows the relationship between language-culture and language-thought by comprehending the definitions of language, communication and culture. Understands the differences between spoken and written language.
Knows the languages of the world and the place of Turkish among the world languages.
Knows the historical development, spread areas and current situation of Turkish language.
Knows the expressive power of Turkish, its vocabulary and the structural and semantic basic features of the vocabulary.
Knows the semantic and structural morphemes related to the phonetic based on the basic phonetic features of Turkish.
Knows the structural and semantic functions of dependent and independent morphemes in Turkish.
Knows the structural and semantic functions of phrases in syntax.
Knows the basic features of Turkish syntax.
Knows the basic properties of sentence types. Can analyze Turkish sentences.
Knows the basic functions of spelling rules in effective reading and writing.
Knows the basic functions of punctuation marks in effective reading and writing.
Knows the basic criteria and features of textuality.
Knows the basic features of cohesion and creates sentences in accordance with the principles of cohesion.

syllabus_topics: Language-culture relationship and the cultural carrier feature of language. Differences between spoken and written language.
Languages in the world, classification of languages and the place of Turkish among the world languages.
Historical periods, dialects and important works of Turkish language.
Phonetic features of Turkish and phonetic events.
Turkish morphology: root, stem, suffix. Turkish suffixes and word formation in Turkish.
Sentence Knowledge II: Elements of the sentence.
Sentence Knowledge III: Sentence types. Sentence analysis.
Spelling rules: Spelling of some suffixes and prepositions, spelling of compound words, numbers, borrow
Punctuation marks: Use and importance of punctuation marks.
